title: I’ve been replacing the AI box art in my GameStop sim. Here are the crayon versions.
author: Repulsive_Eagle6030
selftext:
I’m making New Game+, where you run your own game store from the late 90s through the present day. Every game you stock is a parody with a bad pun (all human titles)

I started with AI-generated artwork and have been replacing it in stages. These are the updated game covers that are in the demo. Some other artwork, including console packaging and cardboard standees, still uses AI and is being replaced too. I have a detailed disclosure on the Steam page.

Honestly, I got discouraged posting this in another sub. I just wanted to show the crayon drawings and good/bad puns, but the discussion mostly became harassment about the game’s AI use. Thought I’d share it here and get some feedback on the covers themselves.

I wanted browsing the shelves to be part of the fun, not just restocking boring s\*\*\* like other AI (without a disclosure somehow) cookie-cutter sims. 

Do these games sound or look familiar? Maybe get a slight laugh out of one or two?

comments.author: mfb1274
comments.body: Please please please ask for artwork from the community on this one. The AI piece is a given but if you get real crowd worked crayon renditions of these from actual children (or bad >!artists!<), I’m a buyer even if I don’t like the game. It’s breaks into a new level of art at that point.. imo
